scope: Single-inheritance local classes, ordinary methods, a Boolean constructor selector assigning a bound self.method to the same self.slot in both branches. Derive names/targets from AST, not program-specific target names or labels.
contract: Constructor then declared root method, fixed ordinary Boolean domain or unknown option. Exact source classes, no external reflection/monkeypatching, receiver escape, subclasses outside source, or additional direct entrypoints. External calls remain unsummarized.
parameter_rule: Explicit singleton domains narrow binding. Explicit false/true or an absent parameter fact retains both possible targets; a default value is reported but never silently substitutes for an unknown caller argument.
graph: Root-to-provider edges: constructor bind-time lookup, entry invocation, self-method invocation and bound-slot invocation. Resolve inherited and overridden implementations per concrete root class. Reachability is structural may-reach, not probability or semantic necessity.
fail_closed: Unknown on mutable selector, binding-slot writes outside constructor branches, method shadowing, decorators/descriptors, multiple inheritance, dynamic attribute access, receiver/bound-method escape, unsupported constructor or callable forms. Unknown evidence cannot authorize deletion.
evaluation: Seal static facts for false, true and unknown contexts before joining the four old Paperless contract labels. Reuse known labels, not fresh generalization evidence; no additional program executions or re-labeling.
scoring: New source-native dependency schema only. Do not manufacture old finite-fixture Boolean features or fit a model. All real scores still abstain and full effects remain unknown.
stop: One restricted real-source binding extraction and boundary checks. No HTTP/ORM whole-program analysis, Saleor extension, new labels, probability fit, database or timing run.
